Extract language from html lang attribute

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html lang=\"es\"><head><title>Spanish Page</title></head><body><h1>Hola Mundo</h1><p>Este es un documento en español.</p></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
